They say below the sand lies an ancient civilisation hidden from time.

Berunah environment

> Weather

Berunah can experience Stormy or Eclipsed weather by default.

> Moon Exclusive Content

Time Multiplier

This moon has a default day speed multiplier of 0.75, meaning the player can stay on the moon for longer.

Sandstorm

Shortly after landing, a sandstorm will blow through. This will lower the sand in the area and reveal the ruins that make up the exterior.

Destiny Item For Ending 3

The following content contains spoilers for completion.

Once the sandstorm has passed, a stairway will be revealed directly in front of the main entrance door. Going down this stairway will lead to an area with an interactable statue on the left side. After interacting with this statue, inserting a "Crystal cube", which is found on the exterior of Cubatres, into the hole the statue's light is shining through will reveal a hidden chamber. Inside will be five brooding seeds and a glowing eye at the end of the chamber. The player must return all these brooding seeds to the ship, but can also approach the eye for an explanation on what to do with these seeds.

The player must place the brooding seeds onto altars on the exteriors of Etern, Filitrios, Fission-C, Gloom, and Utril. Doing so will alter the exteriors and interiors of these moons any time players land on those moons afterward until the player is fired. These changes become permanent on that save file once all five seeds are placed prior to being fired. Berunah's exterior will also be permanently altered on that save file once all five seeds are placed and players have entered the hidden chamber at least once.

Once all five brooding seeds have been placed, the player must return to Berunah and the hidden chamber. A "Chunk of Overseer" will now be in the hidden chamber. Near the main entrance, a lever that a statue is looking at will now be interactable nearby. This will raise up the shrine of purification to insert the chunk into, and a cutscene will play shortly afterward.

After the cutscene, the destiny item "Stone of purification" will spawn behind the ship. This allows the player to achieve Ending 3.

> Progression

Unlocks

End: Acquire the destiny item "Stone of purification" on the exterior after completing the moon exclusive content and insert it into the destiny item slot before taking off in the abandoned ship on Repress.

> Lore

Unknown Voice

Text ⁠
He. Is. Watching.
He has his eye.. directly.. upon you.
You disturbed his temple.. and he is angry.

I have been trying to rid this universe of this being for longer than you can imagine.

The things you see..
They aren't real, ignore them.
He is trying to melt your mind.

I can help you, if you help me.

Bring these seeds to their designated celestial bodies.
It will distract him for long enough.

Once that's done.. return..
And I will make my move.

Sometimes a sacrifice is needed.. to banish evil.. for good.

Stones of purification

Image & Text ⁠
The stones of purification

These stones hold incredible power.
Through the crystal growing within, it can be used to alter matter.

To rid food of mold, crops of insects, water of plagues.
It can speed the growth of plants, heal the wounded, increase their strength.

Only when put together in precise ways can their power be used.

Purifying shrine

Image & Text ⁠
The purifying shrine

This device was designed to harvest and project the power of the purifying stones and spread their effect across areas far and wide.

The farmers most often used these to stabilize their farmland and increase the rate at which their crops grew.
